plan.method: Eight serial balanced Williams blocks; four uninstrumented implementations with byte-identical A/A copies each; fixed CPU/environment; unchanged 112-label scale5/min9 suite; 11 retained samples per focus/pipeline case. Each process median is one observation; independent units are eight process blocks. Full per-label gate; no regression exemption or A/A noise subtraction.
plan.limits: Same machine/toolchain, synthetic programs. Within-block predecessor balance excludes seven recorded block boundaries. Byte-identical controls cannot establish compilation-layout causality. No project builds/uploads should run during timing; other host activity and thermal/frequency drift remain possible. Resource observation numbers may differ; value checks do not prove all resource-limit equivalence.

native_execution.method: Preflight and all timing sources/live output on Linux storage. No evidence export or project build during timing. Copy retained files to the local workspace only after timing ends.

static_review.scope: Selected roots and one-hop direct callees; no execution/timings.
limitations: Address normalization is lossy and may hide changed data targets or allocation/dispatch destinations.
One-hop direct callees are not a transitive closure. Indirect calls and inlined code are not proven equivalent.
Identical selected normalized functions do not imply identical whole-program execution, code/data layout, caches or timing.
Address/size/instruction differences are compilation observations, not established causes of measured StringTrim regressions.

plan.method: Post-primary diagnostic, selected after StringTrim regressions. Each mode/block starts a fresh process containing only the original six StringTrim setups and unchanged benchmark wrapper/windows: scale5, reps9, 500 inner evaluations, minimum reported. Original length checks retained; complete literal values independently checked in four untimed processes. Eight balanced mode orders and all A/A controls retained. No project builds or exports during timing.
plan.limits: Changes session context; does not establish a unique allocator/cache/code-layout cause or supersede the complete-suite gate. Nine raw repetitions are not emitted by the unchanged wrapper; only its six minima per process are retained.

limitations: One nominally idle desktop, same WSL host and toolchain; external background work is not controlled completely.
Eight paired process blocks; retained in-process repetitions are not independent experiment blocks.
Every slower original-suite median is retained; A/A ratios are controls and are never subtracted.
Same-binary aliases check timing noise, not independent compilation reproducibility.
Synthetic focus/pipeline programs do not establish a real application distribution or whole-runtime speedup.
Resource-observable ByteCount/MemoryInUse and tight memory-limit behavior remain separate semantic boundaries.
raw_evidence_hash_scope: Committed redacted files, recursive relative paths
